page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.32xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B physical cores operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. Because the configuration specifies 1.0 thread per core, the 128 vCPUs map directly to dedicated physical cores, eliminating resource sharing associated with hyperthreading.

The instance is equipped with 1024.0 GB of system memory, establishing a high-density memory profile of 8.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps. The instance does not include any GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.r7.32xlarge offers high memory density per vCPU, making it suitable for workloads requiring large in-memory footprints relative to processing cores. The lack of local storage and GPU acceleration represents a tradeoff, directing this instance away from local-disk-intensive or hardware-accelerated tasks. Appropriate workloads include large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, memory-intensive data processing, and caching layers.
